# RHWP Variable Weight Fixture

`RHWPVariableWeightFixture.ttf` is a variable TrueType font with one `wght`
axis (100-900, default 400) and five named instances, generated by
`scripts/generate_variable_font_fixture.py`. The advance of each glyph changes
with weight so tests can tell instance coordinates apart. All outlines are
original synthetic test data released under the repository's MIT license.
